probes.name: every n=2..16 and overlapping/independent lineage uses 3 SQL / 2 checks / 1 descriptor GET / 2P rights calls
Q1 declared sampleSize drives math; mismatched history refuses before Q2 with no partial fields
new permitted revisions during GET retain selected values but refresh Q2 flags and distinct receipt decisions
target labels never affect availability or probabilities and same-game QBs remain distinct
mode compatibility permits both modes and explicitly refuses retrospective serving under a strict-only run
knowledge time uses job completion and preserves the pinned previous answer after completion
P2311–P2316 initial diagnostics remain distinct and refuse without partial results
forged references stay P2317; genuine pruning with an older survivor stays P1666 at Q1 and Q2
independent model/feature rights refusals before Q1, during GET and after math withhold every field
both deletion APIs and independent served-source deletion win over retained values at every boundary
actual handler Q1/Q2 database work matches n=2/16 and observers detect hidden scans and DML
paused GET/private math handoff holds no reader transaction or locks while deletion commits
real narrow LOGIN cannot read private tables, switch roles or execute writer/unscoped functions; model-only remains 2 SQL
missing/corrupt descriptor and a lost Q2 reply deliver no partial result
pre-expiry/abort does zero work and reuses the idle connection; late GET completion cannot run Q2
real sleeping SQL is interrupted at context/Q1/Q2 and ends each dedicated connection without follow-up SQL
